article_title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Nvidia's board has opened an independent inquiry after reports that its CEO was targeted by a suspected foreign intelligence effort, while key facts remain unproven or unclear.
Nvidia has announced that all company secrets were stolen.
The US has closed Nvidia and arrested its entire board.
China and Nvidia jointly confirmed an espionage operation.
tasks.correct_answer: Nvidia's board has opened an independent inquiry after reports that its CEO was targeted by a suspected foreign intelligence effort, while key facts remain unproven or unclear.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בחקירה עצמאית בעקבות דיווחים וחשדות, ומדגישה שהדירקטוריון אינו יודע על פגיעה בסודות ושפרטים מרכזיים עדיין אינם ברורים.

tasks.prompt: What did Nvidia's board say before beginning its inquiry?
options: It had confirmed that chip designs were stolen.
It had no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets had been compromised.
It had ended Jensen Huang's employment.
It would refuse to examine the reports.
tasks.correct_answer: It had no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets had been compromised.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדירקטוריון אמר שאין לו סיבה להאמין שביטחון לאומי או סודות החברה נפגעו, אך יבדוק את כל המידע הזמין.

tasks.prompt: What does “unmasking” mean in the reported intelligence process?
options: Publishing every intelligence document online
Removing a physical disguise
Identifying the US person behind an anonymised reference in surveillance information
Cancelling an export licence
tasks.correct_answer: Identifying the US person behind an anonymised reference in surveillance information
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Unmasking הוא תהליך שבו מזהים אדם אמריקאי ששמו הוסתר בדיווח מודיעיני; לפי הכתבה כך זוהה ג'נסן הואנג.

tasks.prompt: What remains unclear about the alleged intelligence activity?
options: What information was allegedly passed, how valuable it was and when collection may have begun
Whether Nvidia manufactures chips
Whether Jensen Huang founded the company
Whether Congress has committees
tasks.correct_answer: What information was allegedly passed, how valuable it was and when collection may have begun
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שלא ברור איזה מידע הועבר לכאורה, מה הייתה חשיבותו או מתי החלה לכאורה איסוף המודיעין.

tasks.prompt: Why does the reported relationship raise wider national-security concerns?
options: Nvidia controls every US government agency.
Nvidia's advanced AI chips are strategically important and already subject to US-China export restrictions.
The company produces only entertainment software.
Congress has banned all international business relationships.
tasks.correct_answer: Nvidia's advanced AI chips are strategically important and already subject to US-China export restrictions.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Nvidia היא שחקנית מרכזית בתשתיות בינה מלאכותית, ושבביה נמצאים במוקד התחרות והמגבלות בין ארה״ב לסין.

tasks.prompt: What does it mean that national and economic security is “paramount” to Nvidia's board?
options: It is a minor public-relations issue.
It is relevant only to gaming customers.
It is the highest-priority consideration.
It has already been fully resolved.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: Paramount פירושו בעל חשיבות עליונה; הדירקטוריון הציג ביטחון לאומי וכלכלי כעדיפות הגבוהה ביותר לחברה ולבעלי המניות.

tasks.prompt: Identify five distinct responses or actions reported after the allegations emerged.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין חמישה צעדים או תגובות ולייחס כל אחד לגורם הנכון.
expected_points: Nvidia's board initiated an independent investigation.
Jensen Huang said he would cooperate fully.
Jensen Huang admitted marital infidelity and apologised to his family.
Megaspeed appointed external legal advisers for an internal investigation.
Members of Congress asked Jensen Huang to appear before committees.
China rejected the espionage allegations as groundless speculation.
President Trump commented that Huang was a fine and honourable person.

tasks.prompt: Explain why the article carefully separates confirmed facts, reported intelligence claims and unresolved questions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין הודאות והודעות רשמיות לבין טענות מקורות אנונימיים, הכחשות ופרטים שטרם הוכחו.
expected_points: The affair was acknowledged by Jensen Huang, making it a confirmed personal fact.
The board confirmed that an independent inquiry had begun.
Espionage claims came through reporting based on unnamed intelligence sources.
China rejected the allegations, and Alice Huang did not comment to the paper.
No compromise of Nvidia secrets or national security had been established.
Key details about any information allegedly gathered or transmitted remain unknown.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the investigation, the competing claims and Nvidia's strategic importance in 5–6 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את סיבת החקירה, עמדת הדירקטוריון, הודאת המנכ״ל, מקור החשדות, ההכחשה הסינית והקשר לשבבי AI.
expected_points: Nvidia opened an independent inquiry after reports its CEO had been targeted by a suspected Chinese intelligence effort.
Jensen Huang admitted an affair and said he would cooperate with the security investigation.
The board said it had no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised.
The espionage allegation was reported from unnamed US intelligence sources, while important details remain unclear.
China described the claims as groundless speculation.
The issue matters because Nvidia supplies strategically important AI chips at the centre of US-China technology rivalry.

tasks.prompt: Draft a responsible board-level investigation plan that protects security while avoiding premature conclusions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע תהליך מאוזן, עצמאי ומבוסס ראיות הכולל אבטחת מידע, ניגודי עניינים, דיווח ושמירה על הוגנות.
expected_points: Use independent investigators with authority to review relevant records and security protocols.
Determine whether company or national-security information was accessed or disclosed.
Separate the acknowledged personal conduct from unverified espionage claims.
Manage conflicts of interest and preserve evidence.
Cooperate lawfully with relevant authorities and congressional requests.
Report verified findings transparently while protecting sensitive information and due process.
